# T-3: Resolve preset aliases

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Resolve `@presets/<key>/...`, locale, and AGENTS template references through the enabled preset chain.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Registered enabled preset keys resolve includes from their chain directories.
- Unregistered preset keys do not resolve through installed plugin directory scans.
- Locale and AGENTS template resolution follow project-local template root first, config type order, and leaf-to-root chain order.
- Error messages identify the unresolved include key and path.

## Implementation Notes
Focus on `src/lib/include.js` and callers that pass preset resolution context, including locale and AGENTS template callers. Do not keep first-type-only locale behavior for non-base plugin presets. Enforce max chain depth 16, include recursion depth 8, and include count 32.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local unit tests for R5 include, locale, AGENTS precedence, and rejection cases.
